security_control.evidence: The required control is URL validation/sanitization for redirect security. This CWE requires validating that redirect URLs don't bypass security controls. Existing controls checked: triple-slash validation (line 279-280) and host/scheme validation (lines 288-289). The deficiency is that URLs with scheme but no hostname could bypass validation before this patch.

concrete_impact.evidence: Open redirect vulnerability allowing attackers to redirect users to malicious sites through specially crafted URLs that bypass validation
